aboutIntro: Software Engineer and full-stack MERN developer with a strong foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems. Experienced in designing RESTful APIs, JWT authentication, role-based access control, database-backed applications, deterministic recommendation engines, and automated testing with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and MySQL.
